acceptance.condition: The candidate provides a bounded local_chat_wake transport module and self-hosted workflow whose committed interfaces contain no real chat binding or credentials and whose production entry accepts only bounded doorbell event identity plus fixed repository identity.

The terminal-attention workflow, only after successful existing terminal admission, can dispatch the local-chat-wake workflow through an explicit Human-controlled noncanonical enable gate; the H4A2 delta introduces no workflow_run, Work, polling, schedule, or Issue-retrigger wake path.

The browser adapter implementation attaches only to an existing configured local browser session and deterministically fails closed unless exactly one already-open page proves the exact bound regular authenticated chat, empty composer, and non-generating state; it never navigates an unrelated page or launches a replacement browser/profile.

The local transport implements bounded operational dedupe with ATTEMPTING-before-submit and SUBMITTED-after-proof semantics: duplicate SUBMITTED is a NOOP, ATTEMPTING or ambiguous state prevents automatic resend, and persistent metadata remains outside canonical repository state.

Wake construction and submission proof are limited to the exact outbound user doorbell turn and local composer/send state; tests and implementation contain no assistant-output extraction or conversation-history-driven lifecycle logic, and operational receipts exclude the exact chat URL and private browser/session material.

Focused deterministic tests cover valid delivery, duplicate NOOP, missing/malformed binding, zero or multiple target pages, logged-out/wrong surface, existing draft, active generation, pre-submit failure, ambiguous post-attempt failure, and successful submission proof without requiring live ChatGPT access.

hard: Production transport wiring must originate directly after successful canonical terminal-attention admission and dispatch a bounded self-hosted local-wake invocation; it must not depend on workflow_run, the retired PR #1200 Work bridge, or Issue re-triggering.
Automatic production dispatch must be controlled by an explicit Human-operated noncanonical enable gate and must remain disabled or no-op when that gate is absent or false.

The exact target chat URL, CDP endpoint and persistent transport-state location must be read only from machine-local operational configuration outside the committed repository; committed code may define validation rules and variable/config names but no actual binding values.

The browser adapter must attach to an already running authenticated Chromium/Chrome-compatible session through the configured local endpoint; it must not launch a new browser, create a new login profile, navigate an unrelated page to the target, or use ChatGPT Work.

Delivery requires exactly one already-open page whose normalized URL exactly matches one durable https://chatgpt.com/c/<conversation-id> binding, a regular authenticated Chat surface, an empty composer, and no active response generation; missing, duplicate, wrong-surface, logged-out, draft, busy, or otherwise unprovable state fails closed before modifying the composer.

The wake payload is bounded doorbell text containing only the local wake marker, deterministic event identity, repository identity and fresh_brain_sync_required=true; it must not carry TASK semantics, logs, verdicts, correction strategy, roadmap successor, executor/provider selection, or lifecycle commands.

Dedupe state is bounded operational metadata outside repository engineering state. Before the irreversible submit action the adapter must persist an ATTEMPTING marker for the event. A prior SUBMITTED event is a NOOP; a prior ATTEMPTING or otherwise ambiguous event blocks automatic resend until Human intervention.

A successful transition to SUBMITTED may rely only on bounded proof of the exact outbound user wake turn and composer/send state. The implementation must not extract assistant-authored messages or treat browser content as engineering truth.

Transport failures and receipts may expose only bounded event/status/reason metadata; they must not persist cookies, page HTML, assistant output, conversation history, or the exact bound conversation URL in GitHub artifacts or committed files.

If a browser-control dependency is added, it must be isolated to the local-chat-wake transport surface and usable for attaching to an existing browser without downloading or launching a managed browser during ordinary delivery.
No H4A2 code path may mutate canonical AIOS refs/artifacts, allocate lifecycle identities, infer next_action, select a semantic flow/correction, or advance roadmap state.
